articles.title: OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing
articles.summary: OpenAI combines the Chat and Work modes into a single interface. Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans will share a common, token-based quota for ChatGPT and Codex. More complex models consume more of this quota, while simple instant chats do not count toward it. In practice, this is likely to result in a decline in ChatGPT’s quality for heavy users on lower-cost plans. articles.title: Anthropic high junk investment rating expected as Alphabet sheds $500 billion in value. Is there a soft landing for AI?
articles.summary: This week made me take a new look at AI. China shed the first half trillion in AI related business value last week. This week Alphabet shaved another, or their own half trillion in market value. There are only a handful of companies on the planet who could shrug off a loss that size and go about as if it didn't happen. Many believe it is an AI related loss. It is not as damaging as the metaverse decision was to Facebook. But is it the proper AI wake up call which has been expected as of late? The most recent news may start the market reset AI has so far managed to avoid. Blackstone may be concerned that the Anthropic ipo could be complicated by an expected "high junk" or BB investment rating after their IPO. The cloud rental fees Alphabet and to a lesser degree Amazon make, and are expected to make going forward, could sputter. Anthropic could be handicapped trying to build out its own compute with the BB rating making borrowing more difficult. Are these the symptoms of the AI downturn
